blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine Airlines (PAL) flights to and from the United States were operating normally on Saturday, Nov. 14, after US aviation authorities lifted a nationwide ground stop that disrupted air traffic operations, according to the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (Caap). Caap spokesperson Eric Apolonio said in a message to reporters that PAL, the only Philippine carrier operating flights to the United States, maintained normal operations despite the disruption. However, Apolonio said airport authorities had no information on the status of other international airlines operating flights from Manila to US destinations.
